title: The Archive's Own Cellar

features.name: settled data
features.desc-on-touch: Files have sunk to the bottom like sediment. The archive no longer recalls what any of them contained, only that they fell.

features.name: breathing circuit
features.desc-on-touch: Power in the deep. A board that never stopped running hums its own continuity, slow pulse of a machine that forgot why it was keeping time.

features.name: archive silence
features.desc-on-touch: The sound of storage deciding not to speak. You can feel the weight of everything it has decided to keep to itself.

features.name: corrosion pattern
features.desc-on-touch: Metal has learned to rust in specific ways. Each oxidation mark is a map of where water found its way through, which secrets leaked.

features.name: deep dark teaching
features.desc-on-touch: In the cellar's dark, you learn something the archive learned long ago: that keeping is a form of forgetting, and forgetting is a kind of mercy.

features.name: last LED
features.desc-on-touch: One indicator still glows pale. Not recording, not processing. Just: I am still here. Just: I remember this much.

inscription: the archive descended into itself and learned to keep its keeping to itself
